Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

The composer died in 1934. This is a term calculation, not a worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern edition.

[5] [6]
Recording rights
Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis). Documented

The file-description licence is PD-EU-audio, with Barbirolli/Hallé attributed to 1947. The alternative CC0 metadata is not needed and is not accepted as a waiver of commercial recording rights. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.

  • PD-EU-audio — European performers’ and producers’ rights claimed expired.
  • CC0 — dedication asserted by Commons Structured data.
